hooks.command: echo '[ai-maestro-maintainer-agent] Guardian Mode active. The patrol skill auto-baselines if the snapshot is missing; to refresh manually, invoke maintainer-guardian in baseline mode. The skill is idempotent — re-running just refreshes the baseline at $AGENT_DIR/.aimaestro/state/guardian-baseline.json. Baseline covers T1-T6 threat detection (T1 workflow scanners, T2 stale SHA pins, T3 branch-rule drift, T4 protected-path activity, T5 secret-leak markers, T6 package-manager safety-config drift). The maintainer is the guardian of the repo, not a reactive issue-fixer.'
